analyst_view.overall: Early view: Rennes play at NEC in the Europa League on the Thursday before, and they have won only one of their last six matches in all competitions. Toulouse (12th) beat Strasbourg 3-1 at home under Jens Berthel Askou, with Casper Tengstedt their top scorer and Cristian Casseres their main creator.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. I lean a little higher: Rennes' games have produced 42 goals in 10, the most in the league, with 21 conceded. Toulouse scored three against Strasbourg, and a Thursday trip to the Netherlands may leave Rennes' defence stretched.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners. I lean slightly higher: Rennes win 5.7 corners a game (3rd) and Toulouse took seven against Strasbourg. Toulouse's set pieces, with Mark McKenzie attacking Casseres' deliveries, are a real weapon.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards. That already reflects Toulouse's style: they commit the second-most fouls in the league (15.8 a game) and took three yellows against Strasbourg. Rennes are average for fouls, so I stay with the site.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots. I lean higher: Rennes average 16.2 shots a game (3rd) and Toulouse 12.6, which sums to nearly 29. Both sides like to attack, so an open game is likely.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. I lean higher: Rennes are 2nd for shots on target (6.0 a game) and Toulouse average 4.7. If Esteban Lepaul is back from his ankle problem, Rennes' threat goes up again.
